title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University-Daytona Beach
description: Ten under-21-safe Daytona Beach food runs with late service documented by current official location pages; confirm holiday hours before leaving.

cards.title: Wendy's After Midnight
cards.subtitle: International Speedway Boulevard drive-through
cards.notes: Use the drive-through after the dining room changes service, and check the official location page before leaving on a holiday.
cards.short_summary: A nearby fast-food option with service extending deep into the night every day.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Wendy's location page lists restaurant and drive-through hours until 2:30 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through: until 2:30 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday; holiday hours may vary.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell — 2140 W International Speedway Boulevard
cards.title: Speedway Boulevard Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: Late drive-through west of campus
cards.notes: Plan on the drive-through after 10 p.m.; the official page lists a much earlier closing time for the dining room.
cards.short_summary: A westbound option whose drive-through continues after its dining room closes.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page lists drive-through service until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 2140 W International Speedway Boulevard.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Daytona Beach, FL — 2140 W International Speedway Blvd
cards.access_notes: Drive-through: until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in is listed only until 10 p.m.

cards.title: North Nova Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: Late drive-through on Nova Road
cards.notes: Choose this branch when heading north on Nova Road, and treat anything after 10 p.m. as a drive-through visit.
cards.short_summary: A Nova Road branch with drive-through hours reaching 2 or 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Taco Bell page lists drive-through service until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 740 North Nova Road.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Daytona Beach, FL — 740 North Nova Road
cards.access_notes: Drive-through: until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in is listed until 10 p.m.

cards.title: Beville Road Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: South Daytona Beach drive-through run
cards.notes: Use this south-side branch only when the route makes sense; after 10 p.m., rely on the posted drive-through hours.
cards.short_summary: A Beville Road alternative with especially late Thursday-through-Saturday service.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page lists drive-through hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday at 1408 Beville Road.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Daytona Beach, FL — 1408 Beville Rd
cards.access_notes: Drive-through: until 2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; dine-in is listed until 10 p.m.

cards.title: LPGA Boulevard Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: Late drive-through near I-95
cards.notes: Save this branch for trips toward LPGA Boulevard; use the drive-through after the listed 10 p.m. dining-room close.
cards.short_summary: A northern option serving drive-through orders past midnight throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Taco Bell page lists drive-through service until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 2077 LPGA Boulevard.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Daytona Beach, FL — 2077 LPGA Blvd
cards.access_notes: Drive-through: until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in is listed until 10 p.m.

cards.title: LPGA Boulevard McDonald's
cards.subtitle: Midnight drive-through northwest of campus
cards.notes: Use the drive-through for the final hour or two of service; the lobby closes at 11 p.m. according to the official page.
cards.short_summary: A late drive-through with midnight weekday and 1 a.m. weekend closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists drive-through hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday at its 2709 LPGA Boulevard restaurant.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Daytona Beach, FL at 2709 LPGA Blvd. | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: Drive-through: until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday; restaurant and lobby close at 11 p.m.

cards.title: Saturday-Night IHOP
cards.subtitle: Beachside tables and takeout
cards.notes: Pick Saturday for the full overnight window; on other nights, check the official schedule before making the beachside drive.
cards.short_summary: A sit-down beachside option that stays open around the clock on Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's official late-night page lists Friday service until midnight, Saturday open 24 hours, and Sunday beginning at midnight at 2204 South Atlantic Avenue.
cards.source_title: Daytona Beach Late Night Food — IHOP at 2204 South Atlantic Avenue
cards.access_notes: Friday closes at midnight; Saturday is open 24 hours; Sunday runs from midnight to 11 p.m. Other weekdays close at 11 p.m.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Travel-Center Run
cards.subtitle: Gateway North Drive near LPGA Boulevard
cards.notes: Use this farther-north stop when a true all-night counter matters; verify kitchen timing if you want something beyond 24/7 items.
cards.short_summary: An always-open travel center with hot food and cold sandwiches available all night.
cards.evidence_claim: Buc-ee's official FAQ states that all its stores are open 24 hours daily and that fresh hot food and cold sandwiches are available 24/7.
cards.access_notes: Store, fresh hot food, and cold sandwiches are available 24/7; the official FAQ says barbecue sandwiches run until after midnight.

cards.entity_name: Steak 'n Shake — 1000 W International Speedway Boulevard
cards.title: Steak 'n Shake Until Two
cards.subtitle: International Speedway Boulevard counter stop
cards.notes: Check the location page, then head east on International Speedway Boulevard for a restaurant listed open until 2 a.m. nightly.
cards.short_summary: A close-to-campus burger-and-shake stop with the same late closing time every night.
cards.evidence_claim: Steak 'n Shake's official location page lists its 1000 W International Speedway Boulevard restaurant open from 10 a.m. to 2 a.m. Monday–Sunday.
cards.source_title: Steak 'n Shake — 1000 W International Speedway Boulevard
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists 10 a.m.–2 a.m. every day.

cards.title: Round-the-Clock Denny's
cards.subtitle: Ormond Beach diner north of Daytona
cards.notes: Choose this northern diner when you need indoor seating overnight, and confirm holiday operations directly before a special-date trip.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour sit-down diner for nights when drive-through service is not enough.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official page lists the 110 Williamson Boulevard restaurant as open 24 hours every day and identifies it as good for kids.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours Monday–Sunday; the location page advises contacting the restaurant to confirm holiday hours.
